item.title: Mexican embassy bashes Trump ally's claims about cartel operation: 'This post is false'
item.description: The Mexican Embassy in the U.S. bashed a Trump ally on Sunday over her "false" claims about a recent operation to capture a cartel leader. item.description: C-SPAN addressed rumors that swirled on Sunday, claiming that President Donald Trump called the station last week to complain about the Supreme Court's ruling against his tariff regime. item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's latest workout video was roasted by observers on Sunday. item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel found himself in hot water on Sunday after he made a post on social media that undercut a claim his agency made about his travel to the Olympic Games in Milan. item.description: A lawyer was floored on Sunday as he discussed how the GOP's scheme to ignore the deposition of a potential co-conspirator of Jeffrey Epstein's backfired on the president.
